recommendedAction: Use accepted existing operation directly; implement this optional projection only if root admits a concrete reusable bookkeeping gap.
classification: receipt algebra / evidence presentation; not a CV detector, new stage, calibrated classifier or scientific acceptance rule

input.enabled: exact true required; otherwise DISABLED, no projection and no CV

binding.requestSha256: 64 lowercase hex; exact serialized full caller request bytes retained externally, including exact source object; not a canonical-JSON substitute
binding.requestDescriptorSha256: 64 lowercase hex; exact descriptor bytes supplied to projection, excluding bulk pixels but including original-frame geometry, ROI, settings and source identities
binding.receiptSha256: 64 lowercase hex; hash of exact serialized receipt bytes supplied to projection
binding.sourcePngSha256: original encoded PNG SHA256; stager testimony at JS adapter boundary
binding.cropRgbaSha256: exact adapter crop hash when PREPARED/supported; absent on whole-request abstention
binding.protocolSha256: exact pre-run caller protocol digest retained externally; a digest is identity evidence, not proof of freeze time or human geometry truth

input.requestDescriptor: exact accepted adapter ROI/geometry/provenance/dimensions with source image.data omitted and omission explicit; preserve all original station IDs, frames, poses, t0/t1, training, boxes, local width bank, edge settings
input.receiptBytes: UTF-8 JSON serialized with accepted preserveNonFinite; parse after byte hash matches; preserve complete original bytes separately; do not regenerate a receipt from a table
input.descriptorBytes: exact UTF-8 descriptor JSON; parse after byte hash matches

groups.longStationId: exact one station ID in request/each executed branch
groups.orderedShortStationIds: nonempty unique ordered array of existing IDs; no automatic generation, sorting or selection
groups.role: caller testimony, e.g. primary/offset/bright; role is not semantic truth

validation: Strict allowlisted plain-object schema for proposal fields; reject missing, unknown or nonfinite required descriptor geometry before projection. Null top level returns UNKNOWN rather than throwing accidentally.
Verify receiptBytes and descriptorBytes against declared exact-byte hashes; disagreement is explicit integrity error. Retain binding/provenance disagreement instead of relabeling a branch.

Verify accepted manifest IDs and adapter recipe closure receipt, declared source/ROI/frame bindings and row ID/width correspondence. This does not independently verify source bytes unavailable to the helper; label external request/source binding testimony accordingly.
No synthetic successful row for a whole-request UNKNOWN/DISABLED receipt. Preserve support failures and exact zero execution; output row statuses NOT_EXECUTED with null raw references and no deltas.
For executed branches, every declared row must exist exactly once at each explicit width and all receipt stations must be accounted for, including any not in a comparison group in an ungrouped list.

Geometry associated by exact station IDs and original descriptor, not translated crop coordinates. Crop/source branch remains explicit. Unknown group IDs, duplicate IDs, cross-group reuse or unsupported receipt schemas return UNKNOWN with reasons; do not silently drop them.
No automatic parameter changes, ROI enlargement, width search, score ranking, fit-based association, crop/source reconciliation or fitting to expected control behavior.

output.status: DISABLED | UNKNOWN | PROJECTED_EVIDENCE_ONLY; no success/path/continuity/acceptance status
output.bindings: all verified exact-byte IDs and explicit unverified testimony retained
output.measurementReceipt: exact external receipt reference/digest plus unmodified parsed receipt retained or returned by reference; no raw evidence replacement
output.rows: complete station x exact width x branch rows in caller declaration order, including original and crop pose/frame/window, raw learner reference, profile offsets/means/counts/nT, all observation/pairedRails fields, edgeFit object or null, midpoint object/UNKNOWN, source/crop equivalence reference

samplingDiagnostics.legacyPreSearchGuard: UNAVAILABLE if profile/counts missing; FAILS_SOURCE_GUARD if goodOffsetFraction < 0.6; PASSES_SOURCE_GUARD otherwise. This exposes an existing source condition, not a new score threshold.
samplingDiagnostics.nullInterpretation: If fit is null and guard fails: insufficient visible profile evidence under legacy guard. If fit is null and guard passes: source search returned null, cause not further inferred. Never missing physical edge. Nonfinite profiles remain explicitly encoded.

output.fixedAssociations: For each branch/width/group, declare exactly consecutive short pairs (i,i+1), and every short versus its declared long. Pair membership never depends on receipt values; missing/nonpositive/nonfinite fits leave delta fields null with reasons, retaining both raw rows.

rawMetrics.localWidths: Both fit wPx plus rightMinusLeftFitWidthPx where both finite; do not compare to meters or call calibrated width.
rawMetrics.commonNormalCoordinates: Only for exactly equal original-frame headingRad and named frame: u=(cos(phi),sin(phi)), n=(-sin(phi),cos(phi)); originNormal=dot(stationOrigin-longOrigin,n); l/r/cCommon=originNormal + raw lPx/rPx/cPx. Use original descriptor geometry in both crop/source branches, because receipt fit offsets are translation-relative.
rawMetrics.normalDeltas: right minus left of lCommon, rCommon, cCommon for predeclared associations; raw wPx delta as above. Record scalar arithmetic, no equality/continuity score or tolerance verdict. Null/nonfinite input yields UNKNOWN/null delta, never zero.
rawMetrics.windowCoordinates: For equal heading, report declared start/end/midpoint projections along u relative to long origin and gap/overlap between consecutive intervals. Also report raw cross-normal origin offsets; never repair or recenter them.
rawMetrics.differentHeadings: retain all raw local fits but common-normal delta fields are UNKNOWN with exact reason; do not infer physical edge correspondence across heading changes.
rawMetrics.sensorScope: retain station-pose observations separately from window profile. Identical pose/width implies repeated Dev72 sample, not independent short-window sensor evidence.
rawMetrics.cropSource: retain original equivalence status, absoluteTolerance=1e-9 and every difference as emitted by accepted adapter; do not make a second equivalence rule.

nonGoals: No tracker, adaptive path or fitted reassociation
No source overwrite or legacy guard change
No scientific acceptance from engineering reproducibility
nextGate: Root may choose existing-operation-only immediately within already authorized ordinary reversible Lab scope, but P6 itself makes no measurements or repository edits until a separate implementation/execution packet. Any helper source must freeze before release of independently declared P2/P3 course protocols.
